swap_submitted.meaning: user has submitted a swap transaction to the Router contract
swap_submitted.checkpoint: before execution of the submitted swap

deadline_specifiable.meaning: Router/Core allow the user to specify a deadline for the swap transaction
deadline_specifiable.checkpoint: before execution of the submitted swap

slippage_protection_present.meaning: Router provides slippage protection via calculatedAmountThreshold and sqrtRatioLimit, protecting only against price movement relative to execution time
slippage_protection_present.checkpoint: before execution of the submitted swap

executed_at_unexpected_time.meaning: the submitted swap transaction is executed at a time unexpected to the user (after a delay)
executed_at_unexpected_time.checkpoint: at execution of the submitted swap

claims.scope: Router/Core swap transaction execution without a user-specified deadline

preconditions.text: A user submits a swap transaction to the Router contract.; The Router and underlying Core contracts do not allow users to specify a deadline for their swap transactions.; The Router provides slippage protection via calculatedAmountThreshold and sqrtRatioLimit, which only protect against price movements relative to execution time.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: A swap transaction should not be executable after a user-specified deadline, so that execution cannot occur after a significant delay when market conditions have changed unfavorably.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Users may have their transactions executed at unexpected times.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The swap transaction is held by a validator or mempool for an extended period before execution.
Market conditions have changed unfavorably for the user by the time the held transaction executes.
The report describes the delay scenario conditionally; no concrete delay duration or amounts are given.

limitations: The impact is stated as a possibility ('may have their transactions executed at unexpected times'); the plan encodes the forbidden outcome as a Boolean occurrence symbol.
No concrete execution timestamps, delay durations, or market-condition values are supplied, so the temporal relation is qualitative.
Only the unexpected_execution_time impact is formalized; unwanted_trades and loss_of_opportunity are handled in separate passes.
